detail.longDescription: I know Hotlinking is frowned upon, but the hotel I went to for a journalist event, because they added Sightless Scribbles to a press list and then invited me to an event where everyone sounds like they have headsets surgically attached to their skulls was one of those Tech Bro events where they smile and grin as they say climb the gradient, makes more money in 24 hours than I ever will make in my life so in this case, hotlinking is more than justified. I wish I had a photographer there to take snapshots of my eye rolls. It would be peak journalistic coverage. I can’t wait to put my Snark on to the page. This will be fun # WebDev # Journalism # Blogging # Technology
